description: Kinic Wiki connects ChatGPT to wiki databases available to the signed-in user. It can discover and search databases, read task-focused context and evidence, create or replace nodes, and apply atomic append, edit, move, or delete operations with etag conflict protection.

defaultPrompt: Find the wiki databases available to me and show their top-level contents.
Summarize what my private wiki says about a topic I provide, citing the exact supporting paths.
In a database I choose, create a new note at a path I provide and verify that it was saved.
